description: Test suite for the LRU cache implementation in the Mattermost server, including tests for eviction, expiration, marshaling, race conditions, and various data types stored in the cache.

methods.name: TestLRU
methods.description: Tests basic cache operations including insertion, eviction, retrieval, multi-get, removal, and clearing of cache.

methods.name: TestLRUExpire
methods.description: Tests cache expiration behavior with default expiry times.

methods.name: TestLRUMarshalUnMarshal
methods.description: Tests serialization and deserialization of complex data types stored in the cache.

methods.name: BenchmarkLRU
methods.description: Benchmarks cache performance with simple strings, complex objects, and various data types.

methods.name: TestLRURace
methods.description: Tests concurrent access to the cache to ensure thread safety.
